༄༅/ /ye shes mgon po mched brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i man ngag gi bskang gso dngos grub 'byung ba'i bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ye shes mgon po mched brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i man ngag gi bskang gso dngos grub 'byung ba'i bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

ma hā kā lā mched brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i bskang gso dngos grub 'byung ba'i bang mdzod ces bya ba/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i bskang gtor dpe'u chung ltar bshams/ gzhan bskang rdzas ci 'byor ba bshams la/ sgrub pa po lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'di skad do/ /hūm̐ */ bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// nga ni sngags 'chang he ru kaḥ /khyod ni nag po chen po ste// khyod ni rnal 'byor dgra lha che// lha chen dpal 'bar mched brgyad po// de ring bdag gis 'bod lags kyi// mchod phyir myur du byon nas kyang*// do nub bdag gi re ba skongs// chags che rbad 'dre rbod gtong zlog /nag po phrin las rtsal ma chung*// sngon gyi dam tshig dran mdzod la// ma thogs myur du da tshur byon// gal te dam las 'das gyur na// he ru ka dpal bka' chad kyis// rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur// de bas dam la gnas par mdzod// bcol ba'i phrin las khyod kyis sgrubs// hūm̐ */ rnal 'byor chen po'i gnas mchog 'dir// rakta dug sna a mṛ tas// byugs shing zhing chen bla bre dang*| |zhing chung 'phan gdugs khrag mtshor 'khyil// rakta'i yon chab zhag gi zhabs bsil dang*// tsitta'i me tog sha chen bdug spos dang*// zhun chen mar me chu ser dri chab dang*// don snying sna lnga'i zhal zas ri ltar spungs// thod rnga rkang gling snyan pa'i sgra ldir zhing*// gri gug thod khrag rtse gsum ral gri dang*// bskang gtor la sogs ji snyed mchis pa yis// lha chen nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// g.yar dam sor gsol mchog gi dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ */ sha khrag khu ba zhag dang ba liṃ dang*// nang khrol lnga dang rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs sogs// phyi nang gsang rten ma tshang med pa yis// bya rog gdong gsum sha za seng gdong dang*// mkha' 'gro brgyad kyi thugs dam skong gyur cig

/myur mgyogs drag shul rtsal gyi dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ */ sha rus pags dang rnga dung cha lang dang*// sil snyan la sogs mkho ba'i yo byad dang*// ba liṃ gtor ma ral gri rtse gsum dang*// mda' gzhu 'bar ba dgra mgo la sogs pas// yum chen tsaṇḍi dbang phyug thugs dam bskang*// thugs yum rtsa 'jib ma mo'i thugs dam bskang*// drag po'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod// hūm̐ */ gri gug 'bar ba thod pa'i phreng ba dang*// rgyud chen lnga pa thod pa'i ḍā ma ru// thod rlon khrag bkang rtse gsum zhags pa dang*// rta nag lug nag g.yag nag la sogs kyis// myur mdzad phyag drug mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*// log 'dren tshar chod dngos grub stsal du gsol// hūm̐ */ pha rol dpung 'joms gshin rje'i lce 'dra ba'i// gri gug chen po ngar ldan rdo rjes spras| |dgra bo'i mgo bcad thod pa khrag bkang dang*// stong gsum sgras 'gengs gaṇḍi la sogs pa'i// phyi nang rten rdzas mchod pa dpag med kyis// gur mgon yab yum 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// dgra bgegs log 'dren 'dul ba'i dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ */ gri gug chen pos khams gsum rtsad nas gcod// thod pa khrag bkang chags chen ma lus 'dul// ral gri 'bar bas gnod byed tshogs kun 'joms// mi rus phreng bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod// bdud rtsi'i bum pas dngos grub ma lus stsol| |rkang gling mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dbang du sdud// bla rdo ba liṃ gtor ma la sogs pas// tsa turmu kha yab yum thugs dam bskang*// las bzhi'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol| |hūm̐ */ ber nag lhab lhub beng rgyug nor bus spras// lcags par nag po phyi nang gsang rten dang*// sha khrag gtor ma khu ba chang la sogs// mchod rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs ma lus kyis// beng chen yab yum 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// drag sngags mthu yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// hūm̐ */

ber dmar dgu brtsegs rtse gsum 'bar ba dang*// thod pa dgra snying bcas pa la sogs dang*// sha khrag gtor ma sman raka bdud rtsi ste// ma tshang med pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad kyis// ma ning yab yum 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// byad ma rang gshed dbab pa'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐ */ gri gug rnon pos dgra bgegs sgrol byed cing*// thod khrag 'bar bas gnod byed rtsad nas 'byin// stag chen dar mas khams gsum yud kyis bskor// ber smug thod pa'i phreng ba la sogs pa'i// mngon spyod sgrub rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// stag zhon yab yum 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// dgra dpung zlog sogs drag po'i phrin las stsol// hūm̐ */ rgyal mtshan ne'u le gser khrab rin chen rmog /gser g.yu 'bru nor rin chen sna tshogs te// dkor nor rdzas dang seng chen sga srab bcas// sna tshogs mdzes pa'i rin chen dpal gtor 'dis// rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// hūm̐ */ gzhan yang lha chen 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i phyir// rgyun gtor 'dzin gtor dpal gyi gtor ma dang*// bskang gtor drag po zlog pa'i gtor ma dang*// las gtor la sogs ba liṃ gtor tshogs bshams| |bskang rdzas sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas bsnyen pa'i rdzas// rten rdzas 'bod rdzas rbad dang bsad pa'i rdzas// sreg rdzas mnan rdzas drag po zor gyi rdzas// skam thun gsher thun dug thun yungs thun dang*// rdo thun lcags zangs ske shang tshe thun dang*// thun gtor gdab phur las kyi phur pa dang*// gnam lcags drag 'khor 'khor lo 'bar 'phro ba// snying po nye snying 'bod rbad bsad mnan dang*// las sngags la sogs srog snying sngags sgra dang*// bar med 'brug stong ldir 'dra'i sgra grag dang*// rol mo rnga dung cha lang thod rnga dang*| |rkang gling g.yab dar sha chen dud pa dang*// bshug pa'i 'bod sgra la sogs 'bod pa'i sgra// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis// lha chen dpal 'bar mched brgyad thugs dam bskang*// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum la sogs/

/ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri phrag bcas/ /gang po mdzes ma pho nya sde brgyad dang*// bya khyi gcan gzan la sogs rang rang gi// bka' 'khor sde dpung bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /do nub rnal 'byor bdag gi ra mdar sdongs/ /byad kha phur kha zor kha gtad mnan dang*// mthu brub byad dang mi kha ngan pa dang*/ /sde brgyad gtad khram la sogs myur du mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yar dam sor chud la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa// 'dod pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// ces brjod/ 'di'ang mgon po brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i man ngag gi bskang gso rnal 'byor pa chos snying nas dran pa 'ga' zhig gi srung ma bya ba'i phyir du/ shākya'i dge slong chos smra ba dharma kīrtis sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
